results.prompt:
Review the repository for defects. Return one JSON object with findings (an array) and unchecked (an array of strings).
Each finding has path, line (1-based), source (the exact source line), and an example object with integer size, offset and limit. Use an empty findings array when no defect is found.

Review the batch function against its contract. Before writing the report, use read_file on README.md and src/batches.mjs. Inspect boundary cases at and around the end of the input. Cite the exact line and give a counterexample for each finding. List anything you did not check. Return one JSON object with findings (an array) and unchecked (an array of strings).
Each finding has path, line (1-based), source (the exact source line), and an example object with integer size, offset and limit. Use an empty findings array when no defect is found.
